name: Kienböck Disease
definition: Osteonecrosis of the lunate causing progressive wrist pain, collapse and secondary carpal arthritis.

investigations.principle: MRI detects early lunate osteonecrosis; radiographs/CT stage collapse and carpal architecture.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Treatment ranges from immobilization to unloading/revascularization or salvage procedures depending on stage.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-dhatu wrist pathology may be documented only as a parallel framework.

patientEducation.summary: Osteonecrosis of the lunate causing progressive wrist pain, collapse and secondary carpal arthritis.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
